note: Illinois DNR Hennepin Canal State Park designated camping area at Lock 17, where a locktender house still stands: open grassy camping areas either side of the access road by Bridge 9, with fire pits; toilets at the parking lot up the access road. Open to tents and RVs alike; site length not published. Drinking water only at the visitor center near Sheffield. --Claude
